title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）, 2026-07-13
what_it_establishes: 汇发〔2020〕14号 Art. 59: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇.

title: 2024年经常项目外汇政策问答案例（九）, 2024-06-21
what_it_establishes: Same Art. 59, plus: 持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度 (only holders of the Foreign Permanent Resident ID get the annual convenience amount for buying FX).

title: 2022年外汇业务政策释疑（八）, 2022-09-29
what_it_establishes: 个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度便利化额度管理，便利化额度分别为每人每年等值5万美元. 年度便利化额度不是…限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理.

title: 2024年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（三）, 2024-02-29
what_it_establishes: Art. 64, domestic individuals (境内个人): 外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理.

title: 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》 (annex to 汇发〔2020〕14号), Arts. 54-67
what_it_establishes: Art. 65: 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外：（一）外汇账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理；（二）持外币现钞汇出，当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理. Art. 67: transfers between a domestic and a foreign individual's FX accounts are treated as cross-border.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（10）, 2026-09-17
what_it_establishes: Art. 60: 境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；当日累计不超过等值500美元（含）…可凭本人有效身份证件办理.

title: 2025年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（八）, 2025-06-13
what_it_establishes: Art. 62: 外汇局对借用他人便利化额度及其他方式规避便利化额度及真实性管理的个人，列入“关注名单”管理 … 关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续2年.

title: 2021年服务贸易外汇管理问题解答（四）, 2021-11-02
what_it_establishes: 境外个人将其从境内取得的服务贸易、收益和经常转移项下的人民币收入购汇汇出的，可凭本人身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理；税务凭证包括《服务贸易等项目对外支付税务备案表》或完税证明或免税证明.

title: 中国人民银行公告[2004]第16号 — 《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》
what_it_establishes: Art. 2 defines emigrant transfer (移民转移) and inheritance transfer (继承转移). Arts. 8-9 list the documents incl. 税收证明或完税凭证. Art. 11: the bank remits directly to the applicant's own account in the country of residence; no cash withdrawal. Art. 13: false documents are punished under Regulation Art. 40.

title: 汇发〔2014〕2号 国家外汇管理局关于进一步改进和调整资本项目外汇管理政策的通知 (as amended)
what_it_establishes: §6: approval by the SAFE office of the emigrant's former hukou / the decedent's last hukou; the RMB 500,000 report-to-HQ rule and the staged-remittance rule are removed (银行可在核准件审批额度内一次或分次汇出); notarisation of property documents removed. §5: profit remittance above USD 50,000 needs the profit-distribution resolution and the tax filing form.

title: 个人财产转移购付汇业务问答（七）, 2026-03-19
what_it_establishes: 汇发〔2024〕12号 (Capital Account Guidelines 2024) 6.4: 移民财产转移由移民原户籍所在地外汇局负责审批。继承财产转移由被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局负责审批.

title: 深化跨境投融资外汇管理便利化政策操作指引 (operating guide to 汇发〔2025〕43号), §8, 2025-09-25
what_it_establishes: §8 四、境外个人转让境内商品房所得资金购汇汇出: passport; 房地产主管部门登记备案的商品房转让合同及登记证明文件; 主管税务部门出具的税务凭证. 申请汇出金额不得超出商品房转让金额扣减本次转让所包括的税费后的余额. (Table of contents read directly; §8 text read as an excerpt.)

title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号 (tax filing for outbound payments), as amended by 2021 No. 19
what_it_establishes: Art. 1: 境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上（不含）下列外汇资金…均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案 — incl. 境外个人在境内的工作报酬, 股息、红利, 不动产的转让收入. Art. 4: 境外个人…对外支付，应按照个人外汇管理的相关规定办理. Art. 9: unpaid tax is pursued by the tax office.

title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (国务院令第532号)
what_it_establishes: Art. 5: 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制. Art. 12: genuine, lawful transaction basis. Art. 39 (逃汇): fine up to 30% of the amount; serious cases 30%-100%; criminal liability. Art. 40 (false documents to buy FX): same scale. Art. 42 (carrying FX across the border in breach of rules): warning, fine up to 20%. Art. 45 (private buying/selling of FX): warning, confiscation, fine up to 30%; serious 30%-100%; criminal liability. Art. 48: untrue documents, individuals up to RMB 50,000. Art. 52(2): 境内个人 = Chinese citizens and foreigners resident in China for one continuous year.

title: 个人外汇管理办法 (中国人民银行令〔2006〕第3号)
what_it_establishes: Art. 13: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目项下合法人民币收入，可以凭本人有效身份证件及相关证明材料在银行办理购汇及汇出. Art. 14: 境外个人未使用的境外汇入外汇，可以凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理原路汇回. Art. 28: the bank sets the account-holder category from the ID used at account opening. Definitions: 境外个人是指持护照…的外国公民.

title: 汇发〔2017〕29号 国家外汇管理局关于规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易的通知
what_it_establishes: 个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币；超过的，本年及次年将被暂停. 每卡每日不得超过等值1万元人民币. 个人不得通过借用他人银行卡或出借本人银行卡等方式规避.

title: 外汇知识问答：请问每次可带外币出境的限额是多少？, 2019-05-21
what_it_establishes: 5000美元（含）以下的，海关直接放行；5000美元以上10000美元（含）以下的，应向银行申领《携带外汇出境许可证》；10000美元以上的，应向外汇局申领…但原则上…不得携带10000美元以上的外币现钞出境.

title: 关于个人网上办理外币兑换业务的温馨提示, 2020-03-04
what_it_establishes: 个人结售汇业务必须通过具备资格的外汇指定银行、本外币兑换特许机构以及外币代兑机构办理；公司、中介网站软件（APP）私下换汇、朋友圈换汇、外汇黄牛、地下钱庄等其他渠道都是不合法的. 不得以分拆等方式逃避限额监管，也不得使用虚假单据.

title: 外汇违规案例：朱某个人分拆购付汇案, 2017-04-14
what_it_establishes: 汇发〔2009〕56号: 5个以上不同个人同日、隔日或连续多日分别购汇后，将外汇汇给境外同一个人或机构 is a splitting pattern. Zhu used 52 people to remit USD 2.5625 million; classed as 逃汇 and fined under Regulation Art. 39.

title: 银发〔2026〕42号 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知, 2026-02-06
what_it_establishes: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务…一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔.

title: 跨境人民币政策红利不断释放助推首都经济高质量发展, 2018-11-09

title: 中华人民共和国个人所得税法 (2018 amendment)
what_it_establishes: Art. 2: nine taxable categories. Art. 3: 综合所得 3%-45%; 经营所得 5%-35%; 利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得 20%. Art. 6(5): property-transfer income = proceeds minus original value and reasonable costs. Art. 13: if the payer did not withhold, the taxpayer pays by 30 June of the following year.

title: 财税〔2008〕132号 关于储蓄存款利息所得有关个人所得税政策的通知
what_it_establishes: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions (2023 ed.)
what_it_establishes: (a)(1)(A): foreign currency gain or loss on a section 988 transaction is ordinary income or loss. (c)(1)(C): any disposition of nonfunctional currency is a section 988 transaction; nonfunctional currency includes bank deposits. (e): the section does not apply to an individual's personal transaction; no gain is recognised on a personal transaction unless the gain exceeds $200; a transaction is not personal to the extent its expenses fall under §162 or §212.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
what_it_establishes: China Yuan per USD: 2025 7.129; 2024 7.189; 2023 7.075; 2022 6.730; 2021 6.452. 'The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate.' 'A taxpayer may also need to recognize foreign currency gain or loss … See section 988.'

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
what_it_establishes: Form 8938 thresholds (living in the US, unmarried: more than $50,000 on the last day or $75,000 at any time; living abroad, unmarried: $200,000 / $300,000; joint filers double). Penalty: up to $10,000, plus $10,000 per 30 days after IRS notice, maximum $60,000. Form 8938 does not replace the FBAR.

title: Report Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts
what_it_establishes: A United States person … must file an FBAR if the aggregate value of the foreign financial accounts exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table (up to date as of 11/06/2026)
what_it_establishes: Penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) non-willful violation $16,536; 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) willful violation $165,353.

title: Gifts from foreign person
what_it_establishes: Gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate are reported on Form 3520 Part IV only if the aggregate amount exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year. A foreign gift is an amount 'the recipient treats as a gift or bequest and excludes from gross income'. Late or incomplete filing: penalties under IRC 6039F(c).

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6039F — Notice of large gifts received from foreign persons
what_it_establishes: (c)(1)(B): 5 percent of the amount of such foreign gift for each month for which the failure continues (not to exceed 25 percent of such amount in the aggregate). (c)(2): reasonable-cause exception.

title: Frequently asked questions about international individual tax matters
what_it_establishes: 'If you are a U.S. citizen or a resident alien living outside the United States, your worldwide income is subject to U.S. income tax, regardless of where you live.' 'If eligible, you can claim a foreign tax credit on foreign income taxes owed and paid by filing Form 1116.'

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
what_it_establishes: Amounts exceeding $10,000 entering or leaving the United States must be reported (FinCEN Form 105); for families or groups the threshold applies to the collective total. Failure to file risks seizure and forfeiture, civil or criminal penalties.
